title: Scalar compatibility for a functor computed by a resolution counit
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings with B an R-algebra [def-weil-module-base-change], module carriers in a common containing universe, chosen derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] in the same morphism universe, and additive ordinary extension. Let L:D(R) to D(B) be any functor with a natural transformation epsilon:Qh_R followed by L to ordinary homotopy extension followed by Qh_B. Suppose every complex E receives a quasi-isomorphism P to E with epsilon_P invertible. Then for every integer i and r in R, H^i(L(Qh_R(q(r id_E)))) = algebraMap R B(r) id on H^i(L(Qh_R(q(E)))). No universal property or additivity of L is assumed.

proof.text: Ordinary extension maps r times identity to algebraMap R B(r) times identity: check on 1 tensor m using the tensor balancing relation and tensor extensionality. Apply degreewise to complexes. ShortComplex.homologyMap_smul gives the same equation on complex homology. Naturality of homologyFunctorFactorsh and homologyFunctorFactors transports it to homology after Qh.

At any P whose counit is invertible, apply homology to naturality of the counit for r times identity. Substitute the ordinary scalar equation and cancel the homology image of the counit, using B-linearity of composition. For E choose P and the quasi-isomorphism s from the resolution hypothesis. Apply q, Qh, L and homology to the commuting relation s composed with r id_E = r id_P composed with s. The image of s is an isomorphism, so cancellation transports the scalar equation from P to E. Neither additivity of L nor its universal property is used.
